BOOKKEEPING When the cashbox is removed, the bookkeeping mode is activated by a microswitch in the back of the cashbox area. The number displayed is, the total number of coins that have been deposited in the game, and is non-resetable. When the cashbox is replaced, the game returns to the attract mode.
